title: Audit Chronicle: compact console view + robust export wrangler
creator: Alyssa Chen
description: Build a compact, dense Audit Chronicle list view in the Console and a resilient export service (CSV/JSONL) that respects RBAC v2 column-level redaction, saved-query scoping, and SSO/SAML-derived actor metadata. This ticket covers the console front-end compact mode, cursor-stable pagination, server-side export worker with streaming and backpressure, scheduled saved-query exports, and admin controls for sharing/export permissions. Goal: give ops and security teams a lightweight in-console browse experience and robust, auditable, role-aware exports for forensic workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Compact view shows 30 rows per viewport with configurable columns and preserves column order across sessions
Pagination uses server-side stable cursors; 'next' and 'prev' cursors are idempotent for concurrent changes
Export endpoint produces CSV and JSONL, streaming large resultsets with chunked transfer and resumable cursor token
Export obeys RBAC v2: columns containing sensitive fields are redacted or omitted according to the requestor's role and org policy
Saved queries can be created, named, and shared; shared saved queries enforce viewer vs editor permissions
Scheduled exports can be configured to write to a secure S3 bucket with SSE-KMS and a retention TTL
Admin audit: every export request (ad-hoc or scheduled) is itself recorded as an audit event with exporter identity and artifact location
E2E performance: compact view initial paint under 200ms for default 30-row query on p95 load; streaming export sustains 50MB/s without OOMs on worker size 4GB
dev_notes: Backend will expose /v1/audit/chronicle with ?cursor= and ?limit= using stable opaque cursor tokens
Use column projection list to minimize payload; query planner will push projections to ClickHouse/ES
Export worker implemented as a horizontal service using chunked JSONL/CSV with periodic checkpoints stored in Redis for resumability
Redaction layer runs at serialization boundary and uses RBAC v2 policy cache; policy updates invalidate cache entries
For scheduled exports, signed role-assumed S3 credentials created via STS with one-hour lifetime and explicit KMS key ARN
Front-end compact mode uses virtualization (react-window) and lazily loads full details on row expansion to avoid pulling large KV blobs
qa_plan: Unit tests for cursor encoding/decoding and idempotence
Integration tests: RBAC permutations (admin, auditor, read-only) confirming redaction behavior
Load test: export worker under synthetic 100M rows produce consistent CSV and complete within SLA
Security test: scheduled export artifacts verify SSE-KMS metadata and KMS key access restrictions
Manual UX review with PM and Design for toolbar actions: save query, share, schedule export
rollout_plan: Feature-flag backend export endpoints behind 'audit_export_v2' and roll out to 5% orgs in staging
Enable console compact view behind 'compact_chronicle_ui' flag, collect telemetry for abandonment and time-to-first-row
Canary scheduled exports for internal security team for 7 days before wider enablement
Post-launch: monitor export success rate, export artifact access logs, and RBAC denial rate for two weeks
